text:
Here is the result of "fetch" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/3cfe245ae5f381d1844ad1cf7e4c3053 as of 2026-09-02T22:42:44.117Z: {"title":"Bruce McGuigan · Mayor · chal"} {"type":"emoji","emoji":"🗂️"} **Filled card. Not published.** Bruce McGuigan · Mayor · challenger. Scored 2 Sep 2026 against **The Program — A City That Works v1.10 (31 Jul 2026, page retrieved 2 Sep 2026 with the 1 Sep M39 strike applied)** using the 12-topic template and Decision 14. **The letter on this card is a dash.** An internal proposal sits at the bottom of the page and is Joa's to apply or reject. Evidence base is the authorized 2026 campaign site (principles + ten priority areas) and 20 Aug 2026 CHEK launch coverage. No VoteMate profile, no questionnaire, no costed platform, no 2022–26 City term. **Nomination not yet accepted:** on 2 Sep 2026 the City's accepted mayor nominations are ALTO and ATKINSON only. Nominations close 11 Sep 2026 and this card is re-checked then. Challenger: 2026 plan taken at face value, no record haircut. 2018 questionnaire and 2018 X bio are not 2026 sources. ## Card
Field Value
Name Bruce McGuigan
Office Mayor
Kind chal (no 2022–26 City term — 2026 plan taken at face value, no record haircut)
Platform URL (2026) [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/)
Platform lastmod Not published. Netlify, no Last-Modified header; sitemap lastmod 2026-01-01 is a Hugo template placeholder, not a real edit date. Single-page site: /pages/about/ and /posts/hello-world/ are still unedited Hugo stubs ("Write the page content here in markdown"), /volunteer/ and /pledge-to-vote/ are Google Form embeds with no policy text.
Retrieved 2026-09-02

Record lines 📋 (shown, not scored) 0 (no City office held 2022–26)

### The five doors (front of the live card) Each door is **said / record / yes / —**: a sourced sentence or a fact. Never a second grade.
Door Measure said / record / yes / — sentence or fact URL date
Tax cap M66 **—** No residential rate, cap, formula or glide path. "City Hall should make everyday life in Victoria safer, easier and more affordable" is an affordability goal with no rate and no instrument, so it does not open this door. Value-for-money and "public purse" language is scored on rows 41–42, not as a tax rule. CHEK's recap of a 2018 X bio is not a 2026 rate position. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
Downtown order M26 / M27 **said** "I support appropriate policing and enforcement alongside prevention, better public-space design, late-night safety, civilian and health responses where appropriate, and serious action on homelessness, mental illness and addiction." No Public Order Team and no bylaw-hours position. The sentence is scored once, on row 7 (M26b). [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
Housing M6 **said** "That means market and non-market housing, non-profit housing, supportive and complex-care housing, family-sized rentals, affordable paths to ownership and protection of existing lower-cost rental homes." Types named; no unit target, no composition share, no tenure percentage. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
Household bill M66d **—** Water, sewer, stormwater and the combined household number are not mentioned. — —
Written program — **yes** An authorized campaign site with three guiding principles, ten priority areas, a biography, volunteer/pledge forms and a financial-agent authorization. Written and current. No numerical targets, costs, implementation dates or measure-by-measure delivery plan. Two pages are still unedited Hugo template stubs. He told CHEK on 20 Aug 2026 he would formally announce "with a website at the end of next week"; the site is that launch. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
## The 12 topics Column key: **answer** = the mark · **quote or fact** = the verbatim sentence, then context · **URL** · **date** = lastmod, retrieved. A dash is unknown, not a fail. ### 1 · Housing that gets built
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
1 M6 housing supply + composition **Weak 0.5** "That means market and non-market housing, non-profit housing, supportive and complex-care housing, family-sized rentals, affordable paths to ownership and protection of existing lower-cost rental homes." · Agrees with a mixed composition as a goal. No unit target, no 3-bedroom share, no below-market share, no tenure percentage, no zoning or approval instrument. Context, not scored separately: "Victoria needs much more housing, but the goal cannot simply be more units." The demolition sentence is scored once, on row 21. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
2 M6b land bank + co-ops **Weak 0.5** "Public land should create lasting public value, and new development should consider affordability and displacement alongside supply." · Agrees with the public-land-value goal M6b is built on. No City land bank, no acquisition fund, no co-op financing. Community-wealth "co-operatives" are economic actors, not housing co-ops, and are not scored here. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
3 M7 permits + AI pre-screening — No permit-time position, no published standard, nothing on AI pre-screening. — —
4 M7b pattern-book housing — Pre-approved designs do not appear. — —
5 M8/M8b 5% vacancy, DCC cuts, suite amnesty — No vacancy target, no DCC position, no suite amnesty. — —
### 2 · Downtown order
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
6 M26 Public Order Team — No unified command, co-location or downtown operations desk. The policing-and-civilian sentence is scored once, on row 7. — —
7 M26b civilian crisis response **Close 2.0** "I support appropriate policing and enforcement alongside prevention, better public-space design, late-night safety, civilian and health responses where appropriate, and serious action on homelessness, mental illness and addiction." · Commits to civilian and health responses as part of the safety mix. Comparable to M26b (civilian crisis response so the wrong responder stops absorbing officer time), not the same: no named team, no dispatch criteria, no funding figure, no cost-share partner. One sentence, one measure: homelessness in this list is not a second mark. Context: "Homelessness is not synonymous with crime, and public safety policy should focus on harmful behaviour rather than someone’s housing status or background." [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
8 M27 bylaw hours 6am–10pm — No bylaw-enforcement hours position. — —
9 M28 data-targeted enforcement — No position on targeting chronic disorder drivers with data. — —
10 M33 daytime sheltering bylaws — "no one left living on our streets" is the homelessness-end goal, scored on row 23, not a daytime-sheltering bylaw. Face-test: that sentence cannot be defended as a bylaw position. — —
11 M33b drug-use buffer (City: list + bylaw/DPOT + VicPD/CDSA; not City seizure) — Harm reduction is named inside the homelessness housing list on row 23. No child-focused buffer, no bylaw/DPOT, no VicPD/CDSA position. Mention of harm reduction is a dash. — —
12 M34–M37 encampments, reclaiming spaces, night lighting — "Compassion does not require accepting violence, harassment, predatory behaviour or serious public disorder" is a conduct principle, not an encampment protocol, a named-space reclaim, or night lighting. Adjacency is not a source. — —
### 3 · Household bill
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
13 M66 tax glide path (capped on the residential rate) — No residential rate, cap, formula, year-path or override. "tax dollar" as a public trust is context on row 41. "City Hall should make everyday life in Victoria safer, easier and more affordable" names affordability with no rate goal and no instrument, which is a Mention, so a dash. 2018 X "hard-knocks fiscal management" is not a 2026 sentence. — —
14 M66b/c over-collection refund + debt rule — No over-collection refund, no debt rule, no supermajority override. — —
15 M66d the Household Bill — The combined household number, water, sewer and stormwater do not appear. — —
16 M70/M70b provincial downloading ledger — Two senior-government sentences were tested here and both were rejected. "A Mayor has to be willing to challenge provincial and federal governments when necessary, while working constructively with them to get more housing built" and "Housing cannot be solved by Victoria alone, and I will push for strong regional cooperation across the CRD and with other levels of government" are both about getting housing built, not about recovering the cost of unfunded mandates. No ledger, no UBCM/FCM resolution programme, no published refusal threshold. Both sit as context on row 23. Adjacency is not a source. — —
17 M70c CRD cost and the Goldstream plant — CRD is named for housing cooperation, not for regional cost disclosure, a published City position, a votes record or the filtration plant. Mention of the CRD, so a dash. — —
18 M71–M73d business, downtown, one mandate not a new office **Close 2.0** "City Hall should be at the centre of a proud, ongoing Buy Local campaign that encourages residents, businesses and public institutions to support our local economy." · Commits to a named local-economy campaign City Hall runs. Comparable to M71's downtown/business instrument set, not the same: no vacancy target, no Strategic Economic Plan, no "one mandate not a new office." Context, same block, not scored separately: "Victoria should be one of the best small cities in the world to start a business"; City Hall as a stronger partner on transportation, clean and safe streets, employee housing and infrastructure; and "Let’s try to make every dollar we spend on the things that we need sustain our neighbours and community," which is the same Buy Local claim. The separate Community Wealth procurement sentence is a different sentence and is scored on row 47. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
19 M74/M75/M76 capital threshold, short-stay parking (15-min grace; first-hour gated Year 2), permit fees — No 15-minute grace, no first-hour, no capital-approval threshold, no permit-fee schedule. The congestion-tax sentence is scored on row 27. — —
### 4 · Host Nations
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
20 M1–M5 Host Nations Foundation. Topic never drops out of the 12. A dash is still allowed on M1–M5. — Territorial acknowledgement in the site footer ("I acknowledge, with respect, that I live and work on the homelands of the lək̓ʷəŋən peoples — known today as the Songhees and Esquimalt Nations"), plus "Indigenous communities" on the engagement list and "Indigenous businesses" on the community-wealth list. No standing government-to-government table, no procurement target, no place-name programme, no cultural-protocol package, no urban Indigenous liaison. Acknowledgement plus two list items, without those instruments, is a dash. — —
### 5 · Homelessness and waitlists
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
21 M9/M9b/M64 tenant protections, STR, indoor heat (M9c struck; 26°C gated) **Close 2.0** "City hall cannot continue to approve the demolition of rental housing for the construction of condos that are unaffordable for citizens." · Commits to stopping rental-to-unaffordable-condo demolition, which is a comparable tenant-protection / demoviction instrument. Not the same as M9's 12-month notice, indexed moving compensation, documented right of return and replacement ratio, and nothing on STR licensing or an indoor-heat standard. Protection of lower-cost rentals inside the M6 composition sentence is not scored again. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
22 M10 transparent algorithmic waitlists — Housing allocation and waitlists do not appear. — —
23 M11 Housing First + STEP throughput **Close 2.0** "My approach is to build the working system needed to change that: clear responsibility, coordinated action with provincial and regional partners, measurable results, and tracking whether improvements actually last." · Commits to a coordinated homelessness-delivery system with measured results. Comparable to M11's Housing First + STEP operating system, not the same: Housing First and STEP are not named, no 50% unsheltered target, no cost-per-outcome reporting, no quarterly count. Context, not scored separately: "homelessness should be rare, brief and non-recurring, with no one left living on our streets"; "working together around individual transitions into permanent housing"; supportive and complex-care housing with mental-health care, harm reduction, treatment and recovery; "no discharge into homelessness from hospitals, corrections, detox, treatment or other public systems"; "Housing cannot be solved by Victoria alone, and I will push for strong regional cooperation across the CRD and with other levels of government"; and a Mayor challenging senior governments when necessary to get housing built. The regional-cooperation sentence is the closest thing on the site to M11's fair-share demand, and it stays context because this cell already carries a mark. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
### 6 · Families
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
24 M12/M13b/M13c childcare, doctors, youth (M13 school food is \$0 → M13d) — "from students to retiring long term locals" raises age groups with no childcare-space, family-doctor or 18–25 instrument. Mentions, so a dash. Family-sized rentals sit inside the sentence already scored on row 1. — —
25 M13d standing School District 61 agreement — Schools and SD61 do not appear. — —
### 7 · Streets and mobility
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
26 M14/M16/M17/M18 cleanliness and the public realm — "clean and safe streets" is one item in the five-item partner list used as context on row 18. Graffiti, pests, sanitation hours and public art do not appear, and there is no service standard or response time. A list item is a Mention, so a dash. — —
27 M19/M22/M38/M40–M42b mobility + Vision Zero (M39 30 km/h struck; calming is M38) **Partial 1.0** "We also need to start eliminating the hidden congestion tax paid by businesses, governments and individuals when people and goods sit unnecessarily in traffic." · Commits to cutting congestion as a municipal cost. No adaptive-signal programme, no Vision Zero audit, no named corridor, no bus-lane commitment, no calming design, no collision target. Context, same block, not scored separately: "Transportation is the foundation of a city," and better transit and transportation planning moving more people while freeing road space for businesses, emergency services and people who need to drive. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
28 M20b/M23b walking and transit the City controls — "Better transit and transportation planning can move more people while freeing road space" is a distinct unscored sentence, and it was tested here and rejected on substance, not on the one-sentence rule: it says nothing about sidewalks, crossings or signal timing (M20b) and nothing about which levers are the City's as against the Transit Commission's (M23b), which is the whole point of that measure. No sidewalk-gap inventory, no crossing standard, no named transit priority capital line, no published City transit position. Dash. — —
29 M24b/M25b accessibility and public washrooms — "accessibility advocates" appears on the engagement list. No accessibility audit, no remediation line, no public-washroom standard. Mention, so a dash. — —
30 M25 fix roads first — "good infrastructure" is a list item on row 18's partner sentence. No maintenance backlog, pothole standard or sequencing rule. Mention, so a dash. — —
### 8 · Policing and published safety
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
31 M28b business security cost-spreading — Businesses "carrying costs that shouldn’t be theirs alone" is about traffic congestion, lost productivity and keeping business areas clean, not about spreading private-security, glazing or sharps costs. Adjacency is not a source. — —
32 M28d community paramedicine — The civilian-and-health sentence is scored on row 7. Community paramedicine, repeat-caller prevention and a BCEHS partnership are not named separately. — —
33 M29/M29b VicPD funding + regional review (convene-and-publish; no binding other force) — "appropriate policing and enforcement" is inside the sentence scored on row 7. No VicPD funding formula, no Esquimalt cost split, no convene-and-publish regional review. Not Opposed: he supports policing alongside civilian response, and that is not a defund. — —
34 M30 smart LED lights, no surveillance — Streetlighting, LED conversion and the surveillance limit do not appear. "late-night safety" is inside the sentence scored on row 7. — —
35 M31/M31b/M31c/M32 safety dashboard, published enforcement record, crime target — Tested and rejected: "Everyone deserves to feel safe in Victoria: residents, workers, women, families, seniors, young people, business owners, visitors and people living unhoused" is closer to frame than to a goal with an instrument, and frame is not a source. No weekly dashboard, no published enforcement record, no crime-reduction number, no safety survey. City-wide measurement is scored on row 42, not as a public-safety KPI. — —
### 9 · Beauty as a public good
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
36 M43–M46b heritage and cultural venues — Heritage standards, design code, street furniture and designated cultural venues do not appear. The arts live/work sentence is scored on row 39. — —
37 M45b/c pedestrianisation and the signature project — Pedestrianisation pilots and a signature-project shortlist do not appear. Congestion relief is scored on row 27, not as pedestrianisation. — —
38 M47–M49 heritage incentives, lighting, parks — Heritage incentives, ornamental lighting, walkway gaps and parks programmes do not appear. — —
39 M50/M50b/M51/M52 culture, sport, and the arts funding floor **Weak 0.5** "Victoria should be a place where artists, musicians, performers, writers, designers and cultural organizations can live, work and create." · Agrees with an arts-ecosystem goal. No funding floor, no per-capita figure, no multi-year agreements, no spaces plan, no sport or facility hours. 2018 ProArt answers are not a 2026 source. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
### 10 · A smaller scored Hall
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
40 M15 managed competition — "I am proudly pro-union and support living wages, secure employment, apprenticeships and strong public services." · Explicitly pro-union. That does not establish a position on competitive testing of City services, and M15's own worker clause (80% re-hire at equal or higher pay, insourcing a permitted outcome) means pro-union is not the opposite of M15. Face-test: pro-union is not Opposed here. Dash, not −1.0. — —
41 M65 rotating zero-based reviews **Partial+ 1.5** "Major decisions should come with straightforward public accounting: What did we spend? Why? Who benefited? What did the public receive in return? Where did we forgo revenue and why?" · Agrees with the value-for-money test M65 exists to serve, and names a comparable instrument: a published account of cost, beneficiaries, value received and forgone revenue, against M65's published assessment, decision and reasons for every reviewed programme and grant. Not the same: no rotating zero-based cycle, no 3–4 service areas per budget cycle, no \$50,000 grant threshold, no published three-part test, no savings target. Context, not scored separately: "Treat every tax dollar, public asset and major project as a public trust: know what it costs, what it is supposed to achieve and whether people received value for their money," and "Public office is a public trust." [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
42 M67 quarterly performance dashboard **Partial 1.0** "Set clear goals, assign responsibility, measure results, finish what works and fix what doesn’t." · Commits to a goals-responsibility-results operating method. No dashboard, no KPI set, no quarterly cadence, no 30-day publication rule. Context, not scored separately: "City Hall should know whether an initiative actually solved the problem or merely moved it somewhere else." [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
43 M68 overhead reduction by attrition — Headcount, attrition, administrative FTEs and digitisation do not appear. — —
44 M69 real-estate rationalisation — The public-land sentence is scored on row 2. A holdings inventory, utilization audit and disposition rule are not addressed. — —
45 M53/M53b/M53c GIS, AI consultation imagery, LIDAR — GIS, consultation imagery and LIDAR do not appear. — —
46 M53d published municipal AI standard — Municipal use of AI does not appear. — —
47 M54–M57 local-tech procurement, open data, Wi-Fi, EV charging **Partial+ 1.5** "Municipal procurement and investment can strengthen local supply chains, create good employment and keep more money circulating locally." · A distinct Community Wealth sentence, not the Buy Local sentence scored on row 18. Agrees with local economic retention as a goal, alongside "Victoria should support local businesses, employees, entrepreneurs, co-operatives, social enterprises, Indigenous businesses, non-profits and community ownership," and names procurement as the lever, which is comparable to M55's local-preference scoring in procurement. Not the same: no scoring rule, no plain-language RFPs, no innovation pilot contracts, no data-sovereignty condition, and nothing on open data, Wi-Fi or EV charging. Indigenous businesses appear here only as a list item and are not a second mark on row 20. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
### 11 · Climate and trees as operations
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
48 M58/M58b/M64b climate, district energy, seismic **Partial+ 1.5** "Victoria needs practical action on building efficiency, extreme heat and wildfire smoke, resilient public facilities, water management, local food security, public transit and active transportation." · Agrees with operational climate action and names comparable instruments (building efficiency, heat and smoke response, resilient facilities, water management). Not the same as M58's 50%-by-2030 target, M58b's district-energy utility model, or M64b's seismic inventory and retrofit programme. Context: "Climate change is real. It is an environmental emergency and an infrastructure challenge." Transit and active transportation in this sentence are not given a second mark on row 27 or 49. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
49 M59–M63 trees, mode share, ecosystems, emergency preparedness — No 5,000-tree target, no canopy percentage, no parkland ratio, no ecosystems programme, no emergency-preparedness instrument. Mode share sits inside sentences already scored on rows 27 and 48. — —
### 12 · Neighbourhoods and integrity
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
50 M77/M78/M78b \$25M referendum threshold, 5-step process, material-change rule **Partial 1.0** "Engagement should happen early enough for people to genuinely influence decisions, not after the important choices have already been made." · Commits to consultation before commitment, which is M78 step 1. No 5-step sequence, no \$25M referendum threshold, no public visualization requirement, no material-change rule. Context, not scored separately: "Consultation should be continuous and comprehensive. There should be no surprises from City Hall." [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
51 M79/M79b Integrity Commissioner + 60-day consultation response **Close 2.0** "Good decisions start by listening to residents, frontline workers, businesses, community organizations and people with direct experience, then showing how what we heard affected the decision." · Commits to a published account of how input changed the decision, which is comparable to M79's what-we-heard-and-what-we-did reconciliation and 60-day consultation response. Not the same, and it does not reach the M79b half: no Integrity Commissioner office, no MNP implementation tracker, no 60-day clock, no 30-day pre-adoption publication. Context, not scored separately: "Residents should know what is actually open for decision, see a fair account of what was heard, and understand how their input affected the result." [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
52 M79c–f lobbyist registry, FOI fee, remuneration — "understandable budgets, transparent contracts and spending" sits inside the Citizens-First sentence that is scored once, on row 54. No lobbyist registry, no FOI-fee position, no remuneration rule, no mandate letter. Dash. — —
53 M80/M80b/M80c neighbourhoods, language access, Local Area Plans — "neighbourhoods" is one item in the thirteen-item engagement list ("I will engage with residents, labour, businesses, Indigenous communities, neighbourhoods, ..."). Committing to engage a list of stakeholders is not a neighbourhood-association grant line, a language-access standard or a Local Area Plan programme. A list item is a Mention, so a dash. — —
54 M82/M82b community surveys, turnout and ballot access **Weak 0.5** "I support open decision-making, understandable budgets, transparent contracts and spending, meaningful public consultation and more opportunities for residents to participate between elections." · Agrees with between-elections participation as a goal, which is what M82's annual neighbourhood survey exists to deliver. No survey, no publication window, no service-change rule, and nothing on advance voting, voting places, mail ballots or turnout. Neither instrument nor target, so Weak. Context: "City Hall should earn trust between elections, not just ask for it during them." [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
55 M81 Saanich amalgamation (one line, not the whole topic) — Amalgamation does not appear on the 2026 site, although it is a non-binding question on the 17 Oct 2026 ballot. The 2018 Times Colonist line "Victoria must amalgamate itself first" is not a 2026 source and is not imported. — —
## Working notes (internal, not for the cell) - **Verification pass, 2 Sep 2026.** Every one of the 13 first-pass quotes was re-checked word for word against the campaign page retrieved 2 Sep 2026. All 13 are verbatim and correctly attributed. Three changes were made and are listed below; two table defects were repaired; no mark was lowered. - **Row 41 (M65) 0.5 → Partial+ 1.5.** The first pass scored the "public trust" principle and left the stronger sentence as context. "Major decisions should come with straightforward public accounting: What did we spend? Why? Who benefited? What did the public receive in return? Where did we forgo revenue and why?" names a published-accounting instrument, so it is the sentence that should carry the cell. The principle becomes context. - **Row 47 (M54–M57) dash → Partial+ 1.5.** The first pass folded all local-spend wording into row 18. The Community Wealth sentence "Municipal procurement and investment can strengthen local supply chains, create good employment and keep more money circulating locally" is a different sentence in a different section and was never scored. It names procurement as the lever, which is comparable to M55. - **Row 54 (M82/M82b) dash → Weak 0.5.** "I support ... more opportunities for residents to participate between elections" states support for a goal, which is Agrees, not a bare Mention. No instrument, so Weak. Row 52 now records that this sentence is scored once, here. - **Repaired:** the Topic 12 table had a corrupted header and a duplicated row 50 carrying two answers for the same measure. Rebuilt to seven columns with one answer per row. - **Repaired:** row 28's note applied "one sentence, one measure" at block level, which is not the rule. The sentence is distinct and eligible; it is rejected on substance instead, and the note now says so. - **Sources read in full:** [bruceformayor.ca home / platform](https://bruceformayor.ca/) (retrieved 2026-09-02, full text) · [posts index](https://bruceformayor.ca/posts/) · [hello-world stub](https://bruceformayor.ca/posts/hello-world/) · [about stub](https://bruceformayor.ca/pages/about/) · [volunteer](https://bruceformayor.ca/volunteer/) · [pledge to vote](https://bruceformayor.ca/pledge-to-vote/) · [sitemap.xml](https://bruceformayor.ca/sitemap.xml) · [CHEK launch, 20 Aug 2026](https://cheknews.ca/victoria-mayoral-race-takes-shape-as-challengers-enter-with-less-than-two-months-to-go-1343203/) · [City of Victoria Elections page](https://www.victoria.ca/city-government/elections) (retrieved 2026-09-02) · [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCD6Nj_0xO5xDEYAi7W7nfTw) and all three videos · [X @BruceForMayor](https://x.com/BruceForMayor) · [Facebook page](https://www.facebook.com/BruceforMayorofVictoria/) · [ACTW live profile](https://acitythatworks.ca/profiles/mcguigan). - **Site forensics (2026-09-02).** Single-page Hugo site on Netlify. No Last-Modified header and no article:modified_time; the only sitemap lastmod values are 2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00 on `/`, `/posts/` and `/posts/hello-world/`, which is a template default, not an edit date. `/pages/about/` still reads "Write the page content here in markdown. This file lives at `content/pages/about.md`". `/posts/hello-world/` still reads "Write the post body here in markdown ... Delete this file when you have real content." `/volunteer/` and `/pledge-to-vote/` are Google Form embeds with no policy text. `/register-to-vote/`, `/categories/`, `/tags/` carry no policy text. Conclusion: the site is the launch CHEK trailed on 20 Aug, published but unfinished. There is no dated news section, no downloadable platform, no budget and no implementation calendar. - **Social forensics (2026-09-02), none of it scorable.** YouTube "Bruce McGuigan for Mayor" / @BruceMcGuiganforMayor holds exactly three videos, all posted about two weeks ago: PICT0625 (1:03, 22 views, 0 likes), PICT0677 (0:22, 0 views), PICT0682 (0:33, 1 view). All three carry camera-default filenames as titles, "No description has been added to this video", comments turned off, and no captions track, so no verbatim sentence can be taken from them.
